note: The cut of the demo video 'I Saved You a Seat': real footage of the native Quest app running in Meta XR Simulator (clips in demo-build/capture, filmed by scripts/demo/film.ps1), one insert of the companion web app (web/scripts/demo-companion.mjs), a synthesized narrator and a synthesized score. Each clip names its source and the seconds used from it; times in the lists below are seconds into the named clip. scripts/demo/demo_timeline.py works out the film's timeline, demo_audio.py the sound, demo_edit.py the picture. 'view' shows part of a captured frame: [centre x, centre y, share of the width], fixed ('at') or as an eased move ('from'/'to'). 'voice' marks where the app plays a recorded voice in the clip's own seconds.

narration.text: Different cities. Different routines. Some days, we miss each other by hours.
In SameSky, a familiar object can hold a message for later.
A few moments become a day you can step into.
Leave an answer, and it waits on the table.
Share the little things, from your phone or your camera's footage, with the people you choose.
A place for the moments between visits.
SameSky. A place to be close, even when you're far.

steps.text: Footage from a camera, a drone or AI glasses comes in as an exported file\N(a photo, or a clip of up to 60 seconds). There is no direct link to a device.
